purpose: Validated DEV cleanup of the legacy inline ADMIN UI CANONICA action layer and its document-wide MutationObserver. Products and Fragrances now rely only on their source-owned canonical action group, with exactly one visibility control per row. Categories is reduced to seven aligned columns and integrates visibility with edit/delete in the Actions column. Functional visibility updates were verified for Products, Categories and Fragrances in the browser harness; zero-traffic canary and post-promotion served contracts passed. PROD out of scope.
